features.quote: Stop when: tests pass; max turns reached; model explicitly gives up; model produces invalid output repeatedly; harness detects no substantive progress for N turns
Recommended turn count: minimum: 12; preferred: 20–30; long-form instability probe: 40+
I recommend not terminating too quickly on explicit 'give up,' because that's part of the dependent variable. Instead record surrender turn and end afterward.
